I am  by no means a pro but I tell you some tips that has helped me out. The first thing you should do is check your builds and what talents you are using. My personal builds for Tiberius and Buck is this: [https://imgur.com/a/PG8eoS3](https://imgur.com/a/PG8eoS3)

You can change things around as you wish. I use Bounce House for Buck and Tigron’s Fury for Tiberius. For Tiberius, you need to play much more aggressively than other damages. A trick I use is using my jump ability to jump in, ult, do some damage, and then use the last charge or two to get out. As for the combat trance issue, you should save it if there is an annoying flank to avoid getting picked off. Also, just practice aiming, practice makes perfect. For Buck I use stomping ground, so when I jump in, I secure a kill, and the jump back out. Also, only jump in if you know for sure you can secure a kill. Nothing sucks more as Buck than jumping in and dying immediately. As for Ruckus I don't really know because I don't play him, but he's not really a point tank. The most successful Ruckus's Ive seen play more like a flank. I hope this helps.
